answer.title: Automate Supplier Bill Entry
answer.trigger: An email arrives with a new supplier invoice notification from Hot Water Hub.
steps: Receive the invoice notification email from the supplier.
Extract the invoice details, reference number, and amount using AI.
Create a new draft supplier bill in the accounts system.
Flag the draft bill for human review before final entry.
answer.ai_help: Reading the email content to extract the invoice reference and amount.
answer.human_approval: Emma reviews and approves the draft supplier bill before it is finally posted to accounts.
answer.risk_reason: Incorrect amounts or duplicate entries could lead to overpayment of supplier bills.
